b: Modern fishing trips often involve more electronics than ever: Phones handle navigation, weather radar, and fishing apps; cameras record catches; portable fridges keep food and drinks cold back at camp. Add headlamps, camp lighting, tablets, fishing accessories, and other everyday gear, and a dependable source of portable power becomes increasingly important for tournament anglers, content creators, and weekend fishermen alike.

BLUETTI’s Black Friday deals includes several portable power options suited to different fishing scenarios, from lightweight charging solutions for day trips to powering a whole fishing basecamp. The Apex 200 and Elite 100 mini are the two primary models to consider, while the smaller Elite 30 mini offers a lighter alternative. Anglers planning longer stays can also look at the company’s foldable 100 and 200W Portable Solar Panel for daytime recharging while they’re out putting a bend in their rods.
BLUETTI Elite 100 mini: Weekend Power Without the Bulk

The BLUETTI Elite 100 mini offers an excellent balance of battery capacity, output, and portability for anglers planning weekend fishing trips, overnight stays at the lake, or short off-grid camping adventures. With 1,004.8Wh of capacity and 700W of output, it provides enough power for many everyday fishing-camp essentials, including compatible portable refrigerators, camp lighting, phones, tablets, and camera equipment.

Imagine pulling into your favorite lake Friday afternoon, setting up camp, and preparing for two full days on the water. The Elite 100 mini can help keep food and drinks cold, provide lighting for tying fishing knots and organizing tackle after dark, and keep electronic devices charged for the next morning’s launch. It’s also useful for anglers who rely on smartphones for fishing forecasts, weather alerts, lake maps, GPS navigation, and checking changing conditions throughout the weekend.

For anglers who enjoy documenting their fishing adventures, the Elite 100 mini offers additional versatility. Its 140W USB-C charging capability can power or recharge compatible cameras, laptops, and other high-demand electronics, making it convenient for keeping action cameras, wireless microphones, and filming equipment ready throughout a trip. After a day of catching bass, walleye, trout, or panfish, anglers can use camp downtime to review footage, back up photos, recharge camera batteries, and prepare content for social media or fishing reports.

It’s also a practical option for tournament anglers who need to keep phones, tablets, and other communication equipment charged between days of competition. At just 23.6 pounds, with a footprint measuring approximately 9.3 by 8.5 inches, the Elite 100 mini is easy to fit into a vehicle already packed with fishing rods, tackle boxes, coolers, and camping gear.

Nine outputs provide flexibility for connecting multiple compatible devices, while support for up to 350W of solar input offers another way to replenish the battery during longer lakeside stays with compatible solar panels. For anglers who want dependable portable power without sacrificing valuable vehicle or campsite space, the Elite 100 mini is a convenient companion for weekend fishing adventures.
The Elite 100 mini normally sells for $429, but its Black Friday price is $379, a $50 savings.
BLUETTI Elite 30 mini: Lightweight Power for Day Trips
For shorter outings, bank fishing or anglers who simply want to keep a few electronics charged, the Elite 30 mini offers a more compact option.

It features 288Wh of capacity, 300W of continuous output, and seven outputs, all in a package weighing just 7.3 pounds. That makes it convenient to carry from a parked vehicle to a fishing spot, or to include in a simple overnight camping setup. It’s a good option for keeping a phone charged for navigation, checking changing weather conditions, running fishing apps, or keeping a camera ready.

The smaller size also makes it useful for anglers who fish from shore, kayak, or remote access points where carrying bulky equipment isn’t practical. Rather than returning to the truck to charge a device, anglers can bring a compact power source with them. It can also support small camp conveniences like LED lighting and charging headlamps for early morning or evening sessions.

For tournament fishermen, it can serve as an important backup to ensure needed electronics function, such as cameras or rechargeable electronic scales. Just use the built-in retractable 140W USB-C cable. There’s also a built-in LED light that can help when tying knots, organizing tackle or loading the vehicle after an evening fishing session.
The Elite 30 mini drops from $249.99 to $199 during BLUETTI’s Black Friday deals, saving $50.99.
BLUETTI 100W & 200W Portable Solar Panels: Recharge While You’re at Camp

For anglers spending several days at a remote lake or campground, the BLUETTI foldable 100W & 200W Portable Solar Panels offer a convenient way to recharge compatible power stations during daylight hours.

Positioned near camp while you’re fishing, the panel can help replenish power for overnight fridge operation, lighting, phones, camera batteries, and other essential devices. It’s especially useful for multi-day fishing trips, families with multiple devices and content creators who need to keep cameras, microphones, and laptops charged.

With up to 23.4% conversion efficiency, the panel folds for easy transport between fishing locations. Paired with a compatible power station, such as the Elite 100 mini, it provides an alternative to relying solely on vehicle charging or electrical hookups. Actual output depends on sunlight, weather, and positioning; check power station input limits and cable compatibility before purchasing.

For Black Friday, the Elite 100 mini with 100W Portable Solar Panel is reduced from $599 to $529.99. The 200W Portable Solar Panel is reduced from $399 to $329.99 during BLUETTI’s Black Friday deals, saving $69.01.

BLUETTI Apex 200: Power for a Fishing Base Camp

The BLUETTI Apex 200 is an ideal power solution for anglers taking extended fishing trips, staying in travel trailers, or setting up a fully equipped base camp. Its 2,560Wh LFP battery and 3,200W continuous AC output can power compatible essentials such as portable refrigerators, camera chargers, lighting, coffee makers, and select cooking appliances. It’s especially useful for tournament anglers and fishing content creators who need to keep phones, tablets, cameras, drones, microphones, and laptops charged throughout multi-day trips.

Designed with road trips and off-grid camping in mind, the Apex 200 features a TT-30R outlet for compatible travel trailers and a 12V/30A Anderson port for compatible DC equipment. Optional alternator charging while driving and compatible solar panels provide additional ways to recharge, while BLUETTI app controls allow users to manage individual AC outlets and schedule charging.
Regularly priced at $1,399, the Apex 200 drops to $1,149 for Black Friday, saving anglers $250.
